summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing for iter369 (child restricted-location access panel + extended-stay guest visit request with search-first PersonPicker). All 8 requested flows pass end-to-end against the preview URL with admin@5812uganda.org. No page errors, no console errors, no missing icon imports.
critical_code_review_comments: AccessPage.jsx:685 uses Math.round on a date-diff, which is fine for pure YYYY-MM-DD strings but if DST or timezone quirks ever creep in the day count could be off-by-one; using Math.floor after normalising to UTC noon or a plain string-day diff would be safer.
ChildAccessPanel.jsx:122 the 'Save grant' button calls setMode('grant') again while already in grant mode; correct behaviour but slightly awkward — a dedicated saveGrant() would be clearer.
ChildAccessPanel.jsx:34 swallows all load errors silently (setInfo(null) hides the panel). If the endpoint 500s the panel simply disappears with no user feedback.
